'''SMath Studio''' is a [[freeware]] ([[free of charge]] for personal use,<ref>{{Cite web |title=SMath Studio pricing - SMath |url=https://smath.com/en-us/view/SMathStudio/pricing |access-date=2025-06-11 |website=smath.com}}</ref> but not [[Free software|libre]]), closed-source, mathematical notebook program similar to [[Mathcad]]. It is available for Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, [[Universal Windows Platform]], and on some handhelds.

Among its capabilities are:
* Solving [[differential equation]]s;
* Graphing functions in two or three dimensions;
* [[Computer algebra|Symbolic calculations]], including solving [[System of equations|systems of equations]];
* [[Matrix (mathematics)|Matrix]] operations, including [[determinants]];
* Finding roots of [[polynomials]] and functions;
* Symbolic and [[Numerical differentiation|numeric differentiation]] of functions;
* [[Numerical integration|Numeric integration]];
* Simple multiline looped programs;
* [[User-defined function|User-defined functions]];
* [[Unit of measurement|Units of measurement]].
SMath has been applied in the fields of physics<ref>{{Cite book |last=Liengme |first=Bernard V. |title=SMath for physics: a primer |date=2015 |publisher=Morgan & Claypool Publishers |isbn=978-1-62705-924-4 |series=IOP concise physics |location=San Rafael, CA}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Atkin |first=Keith |date=2021-09-01 |title=Using SMath to solve the time-independent Schrödinger equation |url=https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/1361-6552/ac08ef |journal=Physics Education |volume=56 |issue=5 |pages=055018 |doi=10.1088/1361-6552/ac08ef |issn=0031-9120|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Ghosh |first=Chittaranjan |last2=Dey |first2=Koustav |date=2024-04-30 |title=Harnessing the Matrix Method with SMath to Explore the Finite Square Well Potential |url=https://lorojournals.com/index.php/emsj/article/view/1143 |journal=European Modern Studies Journal |volume=8 |issue=2 |pages=246–257 |doi=10.59573/emsj.8(2).2024.20 |issn=2522-9400|doi-access=free }}</ref> and  thermal engineering<ref>{{Cite book |last=Schmid |first=Heinz |title=Python und SMath in der Wärmetechnik: Wärmeübertragung, Sonnenenergie, Gasmischungen u. Verbrennungsrechnung |date=2025 |publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg |isbn=978-3-662-70229-1 |location=Berlin, Heidelberg}}</ref>.
